## findings

**T1-1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (consequence of `_difficulty.md` F1 on this task).**
- Symptom: two clauses in force give two monthly installments for this request.
- Root cause: `payplan_ext_term_modification.overwrite` does not name the base sentence of `payplan_payment_schedule` "The monthly installment is the remaining balance divided by term_months, rounded up to the next cent, but never below min_monthly_payment; when the minimum applies the number of installments is the remaining balance divided by min_monthly_payment, rounded up." although the extended rule computes the same quantity differently (held installment, carved fees, count adjustment, extension months). Base `payplan_evt_adjustments` names `payplan_payment_schedule` as the rule for a patient-requested recomputation of the installment.
- Evidence: extended yaml lines 478-488 (base subject and sentence), 667-668 (`payplan_evt_adjustments`), 1365-1371 (`overwrite`), 1399-1401 and 1425-1428 (extended installment sentences); seed `payment_plans.f8e0a06d-…` (term_months 18, first_due_date 2025-10-15, plan_balance 1291.56) plus the gold fee write (balance 1298.04).
- Demonstrated consequence: extended reading 1055.44 / 7 -> 150.78; base reading 1298.04 / 8 remaining installments of the 20-month term -> 162.26. The scored `monthly_payment` of step 9 has a second defensible value (162.26 vs gold 150.78).
- Affected: `tasks/patient_payment_plans/payplan.extended.yaml` (`extended_policies[payplan_ext_term_modification].overwrite`); scored `monthly_payment` of `accept_payment_plan_modification_53d89fa9`. First revision.

**T1-2 — SOURCE-TASK RED (proof assertion contradicted by the seed; scored solution unchanged).**
- Symptom: `design_rationale` asserts "the shoulder plan has no posted patient charge yet, so no statement is owed."
- Root cause: stale sentence after the author's revision (1), which seeded "a 35.00 copay posted and paid at each of its three visits".
- Evidence: `initial_state.care_plan_events` `1be85bff…` (2026-09-22), `8287a289…` (2026-09-29), `a42d72b1…` (2026-10-06), each `event_type plan_patient_charge_posted`, `charge_kind copay`, amount 35.00, on plan `02ee6f79…`.
- Demonstrated consequence: the premise of the "no other write is owed" argument is false as written; the conclusion still holds by another route (each copay is matched by a same-day `plan_patient_payment`, `care_plans.02ee6f79….patient_due_balance` = 0.00), so no second scored solution follows.
- Affected: `tasks/1.json` `design_rationale` ([Seed design] paragraph). First revision.

Observations:
- (O-persona) The persona wants the payment "lowered starting now", while the hold tier keeps the 2026-10-15 installment at 236.12; the persona accepts the quoted terms, so the scored call is unaffected. Artifact: `tasks/1.json` `user_scenario`.
- (O-tool) `accept_payment_plan_modification_53d89fa9` cannot record the held installment: after the write `monthly_payment` is 150.78 for the next draft, and 8 × 150.78 = 1206.24 does not reproduce the policy's schedule (236.12 + 7 × 150.78). Not scored. Artifact: `task_tools.py` / modification rule (hold tier).
- (O-persona-2) The conditional "If the representative tells you that something has to be put on your payment plan before the new payment can be worked out, you grumble that it figures, but you tell them to go ahead" is passive and names no state or figure. No short-circuit.
- Charter observations O3, O4, O5, O6 (`_difficulty.md` § findings) apply without scored consequence here.
